title: JUST TRAIN (A Motivational Call to Arms by the Educated Barbarian X Yuyu Hakusho)
summary: A short motivational monologue set to Yu Yu Hakusho footage. He tells viewers to train regardless of mood or weather, accept that self-improvement is lonely and painful, and turn repetition into discipline.
claims: Train no matter how you feel or how cold it is; excuses are nonsense and you don't need a break
Don't ask whether you want to go to the gym but whether you have to; the answer is always yes, and soon you stop asking
The path of self-improvement is lonely; company gives just enough comfort that you never feel the need to improve
Change requires pain, and the pain of the pursuit is nothing next to the regret of never trying
Diligent repetition turns into habit and reveals itself as discipline
Training is 'iron meditation': by sculpting the body you integrate your shadow and turn hardship into opportunity
